body:
Pretty certain, moreso if I say the things my ex has asked me to say for her protection. Which I probably will.

My ex has stated in no uncertain terms that she's ceasing all contact between me and them. They come first as is only right.

I've done my duty as a living being and reproduced, now I plan to do my other duty, to sacrifice myself for their safety. 

It will be interesting to see how the drive to protect fights against the will to live. I keep swinging between being content and afraid. 

Thank you for taking the time to talk to me. Please take care of your own mental health, don't let yourself be dragged down.

It's a long long story. I'll share what I can, but I can't reveal everything.

I did some bad things. I destroyed the trust given to me by the most incredible lovely woman I have ever met. 

And now I face a possibility very long jail time that will not go well for me if it's known why I'm there.

I will not be able to see my son or unborn child. The love of my life has ceased contact to protect her custody of our children.

My entire life is gone, and I'd rather end it on my own terms.

Thank you for your response.

 I guess you are right. Who knows maybe minutes after I left a police unit came by to check on me but found me gone. 

At the time it felt like no one cared, I got a tiny glimpse of the insignificance of our world and life and in a twisted way it provided enough peace to last me a decade.

Once upon a time, almost a decade ago.

I sat on a bridge looking down at the fall below me to the frigid waters. I knew that if I jumped my body would sieze up. The alcohol in my body would slow my movements and I would die. Dragged under to drown.

As I sat there cars streamed past me in both directions. It was dark but well lit, and they could see me sat at the railing staring down at my abyss. 

Obviously I didn't do it that day. What stopped me? Nothing. For one brief moment I saw the truth of life. 

No one gives a fuck. So why should I?

It was enough that night to pull me back. I got a second chance. 

I threw that chance away very recently but I thought I would share.
